parameters.name: ExpiredTime
parameters.description:
The expiration timestamp, in seconds.
> If the value is **0**, the rule takes effect permanently.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: IpList
parameters.description:
The IP blacklist to add. You can specify custom IP addresses or CIDR blocks. Both IPv4 and IPv6 are supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).
For more information, see [Critical event protection](~~425591~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the IP blacklist rule for critical event protection.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the critical event protection scenario template.

> This parameter requires the ID of a protection template of the critical event protection type. You can create this type of template only after you purchase the critical event protection upgrade.
>
> For more information about how to enable critical event protection and create a critical event protection rule template, see [Critical event protection](~~425591~~).
